document.title: Annuities or Pensions by the Railroad Retirement Board

boxes.label: Medicare Premium Total
boxes.notes: Copy B as Pub. 575 (2025) prints it numbers this box 10; the publication's prose calls it 'Box 12—Medicare Premium Total' (the box layout shared with RRB-1042S). Shown here only where no Form RRB-1099 is required, so it never duplicates RRB-1099 box 11.

document.notes: Issued by the Railroad Retirement Board, not the IRS, so its captions are cited from Pub. 575 (2025), which describes each box by number. Tier 2, the non-social-security-equivalent tier 1 portion, the vested dual benefit and the supplemental annuity — a PENSION, unlike Form RRB-1099 (the social-security-equivalent benefit).

extraction.note: No Azure prebuilt model reads the Railroad Retirement Board's form; read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares. Unmeasured.

custom.reads: a Form RRB-1099-R, Annuities or Pensions by the Railroad Retirement Board.
